instruction: Candid medium shot photograph from a low angle of a couple walking in a sunlit narrow alleyway. On the left, the woman in the brown jacket (R1) walks forward, looking up and smiling. On the right, the man in the mustard shirt (R2) walks beside her, smiling and looking ahead. They are holding hands. The scene is bathed in warm, soft daylight.
